summary: Defined the contract-first M3 Managed Context and M4 Recursive Child RLM delivery boundary before production work, with English-authoritative documents, Chinese mirrors, an audited architecture diagram, explicit TDD acceptance behavior, and a clean-Profile UI gate that remains unmet.
steps: Verified the implementation authority against the latest official DSH checkout before setting the M3/M4 boundary.
Specified M3 as kernel-owned absolute-file validation, strict UTF-8 decoding, atomically published context and protected metadata, bounded bytes, and no host-side content copy or cache.

Specified M4 as official DSH child-session delegation with persisted depth authority, one child kernel per child session, and structural tool denial at the depth limit rather than a second agent loop.
Recorded the required M3-before-M4 order, RED-GREEN-REFACTOR behavior, explicit non-goals, and clean-Profile live acceptance criteria in English and Chinese documentation.
Regenerated and visually checked the architecture deliverable after its contract wording changed.

Created a fresh DSH Profile with the local plugin installed and enabled, and separately proved the existing M1 loop by the real CLI smoke; an in-app UI session could not be reached because the browser client blocked the local server before page load.

evidence.target: Archify validation, deliver, and visual check for docs/dsh-rlm-architecture.archify.json
evidence.note: The architecture source satisfied showcase quality and generated an overflow-free HTML deliverable at the checked viewport sizes.
Repository-local Markdown links resolved after the documentation update.

evidence.target: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
evidence.note: Typecheck and build passed; the full suite reported 138 tests, 136 passed, 2 explicitly live-gated skips, and no failures.
The pre-append archive validation passed with 71 records.

evidence.target: fresh isolated DSH Profile existing-M1 CLI smoke
evidence.note: The configured live smoke completed 3 of 3 checks using latest official DSH, a separate DSH home, local plugin installation, and the configured vLLM/PTC route.

evidence.target: fresh isolated DSH Profile in-app UI rlm_eval session
evidence.note: The in-app browser returned ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT for the fresh local DSH server before a page loaded. This is not treated as plugin evidence or as a passed UI acceptance.

limitations: No M3 or M4 production source or executable feature test was changed in this candidate.
The browser-side clean-Profile UI interaction remains a mandatory M3 integration condition; the CLI smoke is supporting, not substituting, evidence.
This task is not an Issue authority; M3 and M4 implementation each require their own GitHub Issue, TDD record stream, independent review, and integration evidence.
